text:
Type: narrow white metal shelving unit
Use: storing books, files, boxes and decor; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: industrial, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: white powder-coated steel frame and shelves
Colors: white
Shape: tall slim open frame with perforated uprights, flat adjustable shelves on several levels, open back and sides, crisp straight lines, light and airy
Feel: clean, airy, practical, calm
Goes with: light wood, concrete, plants, black accents; industrial, minimalist or Scandinavian studios

product.name: FJLKINGE
product.description: The long, slender shelves give the shelving unit a light and airy look. And the clean, simple lines make it easy to combine with many styles of furniture.
